description: A dish featuring stir-fried sliced beef, wilted leafy greens, and red pepper served alongside yellow seasoned rice, garnished with fresh cilantro on a white plate.

A vibrant dish features a generous serving of golden-brown, breaded and fried rings, artfully plated on a bed of fresh green lettuce, accompanied by slices of red tomatoes, crisp cucumber slices, and bright red chili slices, with a small bowl of yellow dipping sauce on the side.

A vibrant Vietnamese-style noodle salad is presented in a white and blue patterned bowl, featuring cooked shrimp topped with a granular orange garnish, thin rice vermicelli noodles, sliced hard-boiled eggs, green lettuce, yellow vegetable slices, and fresh cilantro, accompanied by two distinct dipping sauces, lime wedges, and extra noodles on a woven mat.

A bowl of Vietnamese pho with flat rice noodles, thinly sliced beef, white onion, chopped green onions, and red chili slices in a clear broth, served with fresh basil, a lime wedge, star anise, and bay leaves on a wooden surface.

A Vietnamese-style noodle bowl features grilled pork topped with sesame seeds and roasted peanuts, served over white rice vermicelli noodles with fresh lettuce, cucumber slices, shredded carrots, and shredded daikon, accompanied by a side bowl of clear dipping sauce containing shredded carrots and daikon, and a wooden spoon holding minced garlic and sliced red chili peppers.

A vibrant Vietnamese Cơm Tấm style dish featuring a mound of white rice topped with green onions and fried pork rind, a glossy grilled pork chop, a sunny-side-up fried egg, a wedge of steamed egg meatloaf, and shredded pork skin, accompanied by pickled julienned carrots and daikon, fresh sliced cucumbers, sliced tomatoes (one shaped into a rose), a whole red chili, and a side of leafy green lettuce with a dipping sauce.
